faqs.question: Can 😎🔥 be sarcastic?
faqs.answer: Yes — reaction-coded pairs often carry sarcasm when the partner emoji is an angry or unimpressed face. Watch the lead-up.

faqs.question: What does 😎🔥 mean if I do not reply?
faqs.answer: If you do not reply to 😎🔥, the combo usually stays a benign reaction. Senders rarely escalate over an unreplied reaction-coded emoji.

faqs.question: What does 😎🔥 mean from an ex?
faqs.answer: From an ex 😎🔥 can read either as reaction to a public post or as a re-open coded signal. The combo is ambiguous in a 1:1 thread.

faqs.question: Is 😎🔥 flirty?
faqs.answer: 😎🔥 is not flirty by default. The reaction register is broader than flirting; reach for flirt-coded combos when attraction is the point.
